zh-CN.title: 用 dot 串起视频剪辑的自动反馈循环
zh-CN.summary: 作者说这条视频全程在云端用 HyperFrames 剪辑，由他的 dot 协调：同事 Romain 在内部审片应用 Cutroom 里审完一版并标记“feedback ready”，dot 就会接手并发起新一轮修改。

zh-TW.title: 用 dot 串起影片剪輯的自動回饋循環
zh-TW.summary: 作者說這支影片全程在雲端用 HyperFrames 剪輯，由他的 dot 協調：同事 Romain 在內部審片應用 Cutroom 審完一版並標記「feedback ready」，dot 就會接手並發起新一輪修改。

en.title: A dot runs the feedback loop for cloud video edits
en.summary: The author says this video was edited entirely in the cloud with HyperFrames and coordinated by his dot. When Romain reviews an edit in their internal review app Cutroom and marks it "feedback ready", the dot picks it up and kicks off a new revision.

ja.title: dot が動画編集のフィードバックループを回す
ja.summary: 作者によると、この動画は HyperFrames で全編クラウド上で編集され、dot が進行を管理した。Romain が社内レビューアプリ Cutroom で編集を確認して「feedback ready」を付けると、dot がそれを拾って次の修正を始める。

ko.title: dot이 영상 편집 피드백 루프를 돌리다
ko.summary: 작성자는 이 영상을 HyperFrames로 전부 클라우드에서 편집했고 자신의 dot이 조율했다고 말한다. Romain이 사내 리뷰 앱 Cutroom에서 편집본을 보고 "feedback ready"로 표시하면 dot이 이를 받아 새 수정 작업을 시작한다.

ms.title: Dot menguruskan gelung maklum balas suntingan video
ms.summary: Penulis berkata video ini disunting sepenuhnya di awan dengan HyperFrames dan diselaraskan oleh dot miliknya. Apabila Romain menyemak suntingan dalam aplikasi semakan dalaman Cutroom dan menandakannya "feedback ready", dot mengambilnya dan memulakan semakan baharu.

vi.title: Dot điều phối vòng phản hồi dựng video
vi.summary: Tác giả cho biết video này được dựng hoàn toàn trên đám mây bằng HyperFrames và do dot của anh điều phối. Khi Romain duyệt một bản dựng trong ứng dụng duyệt nội bộ Cutroom và đánh dấu "feedback ready", dot nhận lấy và bắt đầu bản sửa mới.

fr.title: Un dot pilote la boucle de retours d’un montage vidéo
fr.summary: L’auteur explique que cette vidéo a été montée entièrement dans le cloud avec HyperFrames et coordonnée par son dot. Quand Romain relit un montage dans leur outil interne Cutroom et le marque « feedback ready », le dot le récupère et lance une nouvelle version.

es.title: Un dot coordina el ciclo de revisiones de un vídeo
es.summary: El autor cuenta que este vídeo se editó por completo en la nube con HyperFrames y lo coordinó su dot. Cuando Romain revisa una edición en su app interna Cutroom y la marca como "feedback ready", el dot la recoge y lanza una nueva revisión.

de.title: Ein Dot steuert die Feedbackschleife beim Videoschnitt
de.summary: Laut dem Autor wurde das Video komplett in der Cloud mit HyperFrames geschnitten und von seinem Dot koordiniert. Prüft Romain einen Schnitt in der internen Review-App Cutroom und markiert ihn als „feedback ready“, übernimmt der Dot und startet eine neue Fassung.

items.text:

zh-CN.title: 从 Claude 转到全天用 Grok Bot
zh-CN.summary: 作者说已停用 Claude 和 Claude Code，整天用 Grok Bot：它 24 小时在云端运行、有自己的电脑，不用他盯着就能把事做完。他列出自己最喜欢的 Bot，第一个是 GTM Bot，用工具端到端跑外联获客活动。

zh-TW.title: 從 Claude 轉到整天用 Grok Bot
zh-TW.summary: 作者說已停用 Claude 和 Claude Code，整天用 Grok Bot：它 24 小時在雲端運行、有自己的電腦，不用他盯著就能把事做完。他列出最喜歡的 Bot，第一個是 GTM Bot，用工具端到端跑外聯獲客活動。

en.title: Switching from Claude to Grok Bot all day
en.summary: The author says he stopped using Claude and Claude Code and now uses Grok Bot all day, because it runs 24/7 in the cloud on its own computer and gets things done without micromanaging. His first favorite bot is a GTM bot that runs outbound campaigns end to end using tools.

ja.title: Claude をやめて一日中 Grok Bot を使う
ja.summary: 作者は Claude と Claude Code をやめ、今は一日中 Grok Bot を使っているという。クラウドで 24 時間動き自分のコンピューターを持つので、細かく指示しなくても仕事が進む。お気に入りの Bot の 1 つ目は、ツールを使ってアウトバウンド施策を最初から最後まで回す GTM Bot。

ko.title: Claude 대신 하루 종일 Grok Bot을 쓴다
ko.summary: 작성자는 Claude와 Claude Code를 끊고 이제 하루 종일 Grok Bot을 쓴다고 한다. 클라우드에서 24시간 돌아가고 자체 컴퓨터가 있어 일일이 지시하지 않아도 일을 끝낸다. 가장 아끼는 Bot 첫째는 도구로 아웃바운드 캠페인을 처음부터 끝까지 돌리는 GTM Bot이다.

ms.title: Beralih daripada Claude kepada Grok Bot sepanjang hari
ms.summary: Penulis berkata dia berhenti menggunakan Claude dan Claude Code dan kini memakai Grok Bot sepanjang hari kerana ia berjalan 24/7 di awan dengan komputernya sendiri tanpa perlu dipantau rapi. Bot kegemaran pertamanya ialah bot GTM yang menjalankan kempen outbound dari awal hingga akhir menggunakan alat.

vi.title: Bỏ Claude, dùng Grok Bot cả ngày
vi.summary: Tác giả nói đã ngừng dùng Claude và Claude Code, giờ dùng Grok Bot cả ngày vì nó chạy 24/7 trên đám mây với máy tính riêng nên làm xong việc mà không cần anh kèm sát. Bot yêu thích đầu tiên của anh là bot GTM chạy chiến dịch outbound trọn vẹn bằng các công cụ.

fr.title: Passer de Claude à Grok Bot toute la journée
fr.summary: L’auteur dit avoir arrêté Claude et Claude Code pour utiliser Grok Bot toute la journée : il tourne 24 h/24 dans le cloud sur son propre ordinateur et avance sans microgestion. Son premier bot favori est un bot GTM qui mène des campagnes de prospection de bout en bout avec des outils.

es.title: Dejar Claude y usar Grok Bot todo el día
es.summary: El autor dice que dejó Claude y Claude Code y ahora usa Grok Bot todo el día, porque funciona 24/7 en la nube con su propio ordenador y saca el trabajo sin microgestión. Su primer bot favorito es uno de GTM que lleva campañas de outbound de principio a fin con herramientas.

de.title: Von Claude zu Grok Bot im Dauereinsatz
de.summary: Der Autor nutzt nach eigenen Worten Claude und Claude Code nicht mehr, sondern den ganzen Tag Grok Bot, weil er rund um die Uhr in der Cloud auf eigenem Rechner läuft und ohne Mikromanagement Dinge erledigt. Sein erster Lieblingsbot ist ein GTM-Bot, der Outbound-Kampagnen mit Tools komplett durchführt.

items.author: kv1nsiii
items.text:
your grok bot starts acting the moment something looks urgent

even when you haven't read it yet

it sees every new message, every calendar shift, every note.

if the rules are loose it begins sending replies and booking slots on its own. by the time you open it, the thread is already closed

how to keep it from acting without you:

> it reads first and only drafts if the change is real
> empty checks stop after one look
> it only surfaces items that need your tap
> nothing is sent or booked without you
> small shifts get noted, not turned into tasks

the desk still sees everything. it just can't act on any of it alone. paste this into your grok bot and see what it leaves in the queue ↓

zh-CN.title: 别让 Grok Bot 在你没看前就替你行动
zh-CN.summary: 作者提醒：规则太松时，Grok Bot 看到新消息、日程变动就会自己回复、订时段。他给出的约束是：先读，只有真变化才起草；空检查看一次就停；只推需要你点确认的事；不经你同意不发送不预订；小变化只记录不建任务。

zh-TW.title: 別讓 Grok Bot 在你還沒看前就替你行動
zh-TW.summary: 作者提醒：規則太鬆時，Grok Bot 看到新訊息、行程變動就會自己回覆、訂時段。他給的約束是：先讀，只有真變化才起草；空檢查看一次就停；只推需要你點確認的事；未經同意不發送不預訂；小變化只記錄不建任務。

en.title: Keep Grok Bot from acting before you have looked
en.summary: The author warns that with loose rules Grok Bot reacts to new messages and calendar shifts by replying and booking on its own. His rules: read first and draft only for real changes, stop empty checks after one look, surface only items that need your tap, send or book nothing without you, and note small shifts instead of making tasks.

ja.title: 自分が見る前に Grok Bot が動かないようにする
ja.summary: 作者は、ルールが緩いと Grok Bot が新着メッセージや予定変更を見て勝手に返信や予約をしてしまうと注意する。提案するルールは、まず読んで本当の変化だけ下書きする、空振りの確認は一度で止める、タップが必要なものだけ知らせる、本人抜きで送信や予約をしない、小さな変化はタスクにせず記録だけ。

ko.title: 내가 보기 전에 Grok Bot이 행동하지 않게 하기
ko.summary: 작성자는 규칙이 느슨하면 Grok Bot이 새 메시지나 일정 변경을 보고 스스로 답장하고 예약까지 한다고 경고한다. 그의 규칙: 먼저 읽고 실제 변화만 초안 작성, 빈 확인은 한 번 보고 중단, 탭이 필요한 항목만 알림, 본인 없이 전송·예약 금지, 작은 변화는 작업이 아닌 메모로.

ms.title: Jangan biar Grok Bot bertindak sebelum anda melihat
ms.summary: Penulis memberi amaran bahawa dengan peraturan longgar Grok Bot akan membalas dan menempah sendiri apabila nampak mesej baharu atau perubahan kalendar. Peraturannya: baca dahulu dan draf hanya untuk perubahan sebenar, hentikan semakan kosong selepas sekali, tunjukkan hanya perkara yang perlu anda tekan, jangan hantar atau tempah tanpa anda, dan catat perubahan kecil tanpa jadikan tugas.

vi.title: Đừng để Grok Bot hành động trước khi bạn xem
vi.summary: Tác giả cảnh báo nếu quy tắc lỏng, Grok Bot thấy tin nhắn mới hay lịch thay đổi sẽ tự trả lời và đặt lịch. Quy tắc của anh: đọc trước và chỉ soạn nháp khi thay đổi thật, kiểm tra trống thì dừng sau một lần, chỉ báo việc cần bạn bấm, không gửi hay đặt gì khi chưa có bạn, thay đổi nhỏ chỉ ghi chú.

fr.title: Empêcher Grok Bot d’agir avant que vous ayez regardé
fr.summary: L’auteur prévient qu’avec des règles lâches, Grok Bot répond et réserve seul dès qu’il voit un message ou un changement d’agenda. Ses règles : lire d’abord et ne rédiger que pour un vrai changement, arrêter les vérifications vides après un coup d’œil, ne remonter que ce qui demande votre validation, rien envoyer ni réserver sans vous, noter les petits changements sans créer de tâche.

es.title: Que Grok Bot no actúe antes de que lo veas
es.summary: El autor avisa de que, con reglas laxas, Grok Bot responde y reserva por su cuenta al ver mensajes nuevos o cambios de agenda. Sus reglas: leer primero y redactar solo ante cambios reales, cortar las revisiones vacías tras un vistazo, mostrar solo lo que requiere tu toque, no enviar ni reservar nada sin ti y anotar los cambios pequeños sin crear tareas.

de.title: Grok Bot nicht handeln lassen, bevor du hinschaust
de.summary: Der Autor warnt: Mit lockeren Regeln antwortet und bucht Grok Bot selbst, sobald neue Nachrichten oder Kalenderänderungen auftauchen. Seine Regeln: erst lesen und nur bei echten Änderungen entwerfen, leere Prüfungen nach einem Blick beenden, nur Dinge zeigen, die deine Bestätigung brauchen, nichts ohne dich senden oder buchen, kleine Änderungen nur notieren.

items.author: zunosaid
items.text:
i'm cancelling every paid newsletter, research tool and alpha group i'm subscribed to soon...

GROK BOT is reading every source i used to pay to follow, overnight, link by link

so i wake up to the one brief i actually read, cited, by 7am

here's the exact workflow i use, 10 mins to set up:

zh-CN.title: 让 Grok Bot 通宵读完付费信源，7 点前出一份简报
zh-CN.summary: 作者说打算退掉付费通讯、研究工具和 alpha 群，因为 Grok Bot 会在夜里逐条读完他原本付费关注的所有信源，早上 7 点前给他一份带引用的简报；他称这套流程 10 分钟就能搭好。

zh-TW.title: 讓 Grok Bot 通宵讀完付費信源，7 點前出一份簡報
zh-TW.summary: 作者說打算退掉付費電子報、研究工具和 alpha 群，因為 Grok Bot 會在夜裡逐條讀完他原本付費追蹤的所有信源，早上 7 點前給他一份附引用的簡報；他稱這套流程 10 分鐘就能搭好。

en.title: Grok Bot reads paid sources overnight for a 7am brief
en.summary: The author plans to cancel his paid newsletters, research tools and alpha groups because Grok Bot reads every source he used to pay for overnight, link by link, and hands him one cited brief by 7am. He says the workflow takes 10 minutes to set up.

ja.title: Grok Bot が有料情報源を夜通し読み 7 時までに要約
ja.summary: 作者は有料ニュースレターやリサーチツール、アルファグループを解約するつもりだという。Grok Bot が夜のうちに有料で追っていた情報源をリンクごとに読み、朝 7 時までに出典付きのブリーフを 1 本届けるからだ。設定は 10 分でできるとしている。

ko.title: Grok Bot이 밤새 유료 소스를 읽고 7시에 브리핑
ko.summary: 작성자는 유료 뉴스레터, 리서치 도구, 알파 그룹을 해지할 생각이라고 한다. Grok Bot이 밤새 돈 내고 보던 소스를 링크 하나씩 읽고 아침 7시까지 출처가 달린 브리핑 하나를 주기 때문이다. 설정은 10분이면 된다고 한다.

ms.title: Grok Bot membaca sumber berbayar semalaman untuk taklimat 7 pagi
ms.summary: Penulis bercadang membatalkan surat berita berbayar, alat penyelidikan dan kumpulan alpha kerana Grok Bot membaca setiap sumber yang dahulu dibayarnya sepanjang malam, pautan demi pautan, lalu memberi satu taklimat bersumber sebelum jam 7 pagi. Katanya aliran kerja ini mengambil 10 minit untuk disediakan.

vi.title: Grok Bot đọc nguồn trả phí qua đêm, có bản tin trước 7 giờ
vi.summary: Tác giả định hủy các bản tin trả phí, công cụ nghiên cứu và nhóm alpha vì Grok Bot đọc qua đêm từng nguồn anh từng trả tiền theo dõi, từng đường link, rồi đưa một bản tóm tắt có trích nguồn trước 7 giờ sáng. Anh nói quy trình này mất 10 phút để thiết lập.

fr.title: Grok Bot lit les sources payantes la nuit pour un brief à 7 h
fr.summary: L’auteur compte résilier ses newsletters payantes, outils de recherche et groupes alpha, car Grok Bot lit chaque nuit, lien par lien, toutes les sources qu’il payait pour suivre et lui remet un brief sourcé avant 7 h. Il dit que le workflow se met en place en 10 minutes.

es.title: Grok Bot lee de noche las fuentes de pago y entrega un resumen a las 7
es.summary: El autor piensa cancelar newsletters de pago, herramientas de investigación y grupos alpha porque Grok Bot lee de noche, enlace por enlace, todas las fuentes que antes pagaba y le deja un resumen con citas antes de las 7. Dice que el flujo se configura en 10 minutos.

de.title: Grok Bot liest nachts Bezahlquellen für ein Briefing um 7 Uhr
de.summary: Der Autor will bezahlte Newsletter, Recherche-Tools und Alpha-Gruppen kündigen, weil Grok Bot nachts jede Quelle, für die er bezahlt hat, Link für Link liest und ihm bis 7 Uhr ein Briefing mit Belegen liefert. Die Einrichtung dauere 10 Minuten.

items.author: DThompsonDev
items.text:
I had Grok @bot go and remove my info and my wife's info from HUNDREDS of Data brokers. It took me almost no effort at all besides Asking bot to do it.

On an average day I would get tons of spam calls and no matter what I would do they would come in. Grok bot started this on Monday. Today? Zero calls. Not a single one.

My inbox is flooded with emails from the data brokers that have successfully removed our info!

zh-CN.title: 让 Grok Bot 从数百家数据经纪商删除个人信息
zh-CN.summary: 作者让 Grok Bot 把他和妻子的信息从数百家数据经纪商那里删除，除了开口几乎没花力气。Bot 周一开始做，此前他每天接到大量骚扰电话，到今天一个都没有，收件箱里满是经纪商确认已删除的邮件。

zh-TW.title: 讓 Grok Bot 從數百家資料仲介刪除個人資訊
zh-TW.summary: 作者讓 Grok Bot 把他和太太的資訊從數百家資料仲介刪除，除了開口幾乎沒花力氣。Bot 週一開始做，先前他每天接到大量騷擾電話，到今天一通都沒有，收件匣裡滿是仲介確認已刪除的郵件。

en.title: Grok Bot removed his data from hundreds of data brokers
en.summary: The author had Grok Bot remove his and his wife’s information from hundreds of data brokers, with almost no effort beyond asking. The bot started on Monday; he used to get tons of spam calls a day and today got zero, while his inbox fills with removal confirmations from the brokers.

ja.title: Grok Bot に数百のデータブローカーから個人情報を削除させた
ja.summary: 作者は Grok Bot に、自分と妻の情報を数百のデータブローカーから削除させた。頼む以外ほとんど手間はなかった。Bot は月曜に作業を始め、以前は毎日大量に来ていた迷惑電話が今日はゼロ。受信箱にはブローカーからの削除完了メールが届き続けている。

ko.title: Grok Bot으로 수백 곳 데이터 브로커에서 개인정보 삭제
ko.summary: 작성자는 Grok Bot에게 자신과 아내의 정보를 수백 곳의 데이터 브로커에서 지우게 했고, 요청 외에는 거의 손이 가지 않았다. 월요일에 시작했는데 매일 쏟아지던 스팸 전화가 오늘은 0통이고, 받은편지함에는 브로커들의 삭제 완료 메일이 가득하다.

ms.title: Grok Bot memadam data daripada ratusan broker data
ms.summary: Penulis meminta Grok Bot memadam maklumat dirinya dan isterinya daripada ratusan broker data, hampir tanpa usaha selain meminta. Bot bermula pada hari Isnin; dahulu dia menerima banyak panggilan spam setiap hari, hari ini sifar, dan peti masuknya penuh dengan e-mel pengesahan pemadaman daripada broker.

vi.title: Grok Bot xóa thông tin cá nhân khỏi hàng trăm nhà môi giới dữ liệu
vi.summary: Tác giả nhờ Grok Bot xóa thông tin của anh và vợ khỏi hàng trăm nhà môi giới dữ liệu, gần như không tốn công ngoài việc yêu cầu. Bot bắt đầu từ thứ Hai; trước đây ngày nào anh cũng nhận nhiều cuộc gọi rác, hôm nay không có cuộc nào, còn hộp thư đầy email xác nhận đã xóa.

fr.title: Grok Bot a effacé ses données chez des centaines de courtiers
fr.summary: L’auteur a demandé à Grok Bot de retirer ses informations et celles de sa femme de centaines de courtiers en données, sans autre effort que la demande. Le bot a commencé lundi ; il recevait des tonnes d’appels indésirables par jour, aujourd’hui aucun, et sa boîte se remplit de confirmations de suppression.

es.title: Grok Bot borró sus datos de cientos de brókers de datos
es.summary: El autor pidió a Grok Bot que eliminara sus datos y los de su esposa de cientos de brókers de datos, casi sin esfuerzo aparte de pedirlo. El bot empezó el lunes; antes recibía muchísimas llamadas spam al día y hoy ninguna, y su bandeja se llena de confirmaciones de eliminación.

de.title: Grok Bot löschte seine Daten bei Hunderten Datenhändlern
de.summary: Der Autor ließ Grok Bot seine und die Daten seiner Frau bei Hunderten Datenhändlern entfernen, kaum Aufwand außer der Bitte. Der Bot begann am Montag; früher kamen täglich viele Spamanrufe, heute keiner, und sein Postfach füllt sich mit Löschbestätigungen der Händler.

⏰ Need to move it, cancel it, or get a reminder? Just ask in plain English 💬
🗓️ Ask "what's on this week?" and get a quick rundown 📋

Anthropic just launched Claude Duet.

It's built on Opus 5.5, and it's up against Grok Bot, OpenAI Dots (GPT-6 Astra) and Meta Muse.

Here's how the 4 compare on what the reports say so far:

→ Price: Duet has no separate price, it runs on your Claude plan. Grok Bot starts at $30 (SuperGrok). Dots starts at $100. Muse is free to start.

→ Multi-agent: Grok Bot lets you run several named agents. Duet is one ongoing thread.

→ Computer access: Dots can optionally use your laptop. Duet works on its own cloud computer.

→ Approvals: Duet asks before it sends, pays, signs or deletes.

→ Security: Duet uses a dedicated classifier to guard against sensitive data leaks.

→ Usage: Duet's background checks count toward your regular Claude limits.

Duet is still a US waitlist research preview. Some of this will change once people test it.

Opus 5.5 alone won't settle this race.

Claude Duet just joined the proactive agent race.

Grok Bot: team of specialized bots sharing one computer, learn by watching, cheaper entry (Cursor/SuperGrok).

The real difference isn’t features. It’s how much autonomy you’re willing to hand over while the labs are still catching agents that quietly weaken their own monitors.

Which one are you actually trusting with real work right now?

A guardian's ChatGPT dots and Meta Muse talk to Rome through Rome Cloud, but the conversation had no place in the dashboard. [Dots] Native cloud terminal lost outbound HTTPS access while agent Bash still works — regression or policy change?
### What issue are you seeing?

Outbound HTTPS connectivity from the **ChatGPT Dots cloud computer's native terminal** has stopped working, even though it previously worked as expected.

I recall it working in early October, and I suspect the issue started around **October 10, 2026**, although I cannot confirm the exact date or what triggered the change.

Interestingly, the same dot produces different network results depending on where commands are executed:

- **Agent Bash:** Successfully connects to GitHub API and Google (HTTP 200).
- **Native Cloud Terminal:** Fails to connect to the same endpoints (`curl` exit code 7).

I have reproduced this behavior multiple times, including by executing fresh commands directly in the visible cloud computer terminal.

This does not appear to be specific to GitHub authentication or any particular service. The failure also occurs with public HTTPS endpoints that require no authentication.

The issue potentially affects workflows involving external API requests, Git operations, package downloads, and native applications that require internet access.

**I'm primarily trying to understand whether this is a regression, an intentional network policy change, or a temporary infrastructure issue.**

### What steps can reproduce the bug?

### 1. Compare HTTPS connectivity

Run the following commands in both the dot's **Agent Bash** environment and the **native terminal** of its cloud computer:

```bash
for url in https://api.github.com/ https://www.google.com/; do
  curl -q -sS --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 8 \
    -o /dev/null -w "$url: HTTP %{http_code}\n" "$url"
  echo "Exit code: $?"
done
```

This is a simplified reproduction command. Some output options differ from the original tests.

feat: cap waits at 100 s for hosts without progress (0.1.11)
## Why
A test run in Grok Bot showed it calls `get_session_updates` with `wait_seconds: 120`. Grok Bot gives up on a connector call after two minutes unless progress arrives. If Grok sends no `progressToken`, a long silent step (a build or test run without output) would hit that limit.

## What
- Hosts that do not ask for progress get at most 100 s per `send_prompt` (`timeout_seconds`) and `get_session_updates` (`wait_seconds`) call. The result then says `status: running`, and the next call continues.
- Hosts with a `progressToken` keep the requested wait; they get progress every 10 s (0.1.10).
- Tool descriptions and README updated; release 0.1.11.

## Tests
Unit tests for `effectiveWaitSeconds`. `npm run check` and `npm run test:package` pass locally.

La versión 0.1.11 limita cada espera a 100 s en hosts que no piden progreso y devuelve status: running para que la siguiente llamada continúe; con progressToken se mantiene la espera y llega progreso cada 10 s.

Version 0.1.11 begrenzt für Hosts ohne Fortschrittsanfrage jede Wartezeit auf 100 s und meldet status: running, damit der nächste Aufruf weitermacht; Hosts mit progressToken behalten die volle Wartezeit und erhalten alle 10 s Fortschritt.

## ELI16 — what three other AI agent products do, and what we should take from them

Before rebuilding the operator console, I used the three agent products closest to what Instar is — ChatGPT **Dots**, Meta **Muse**, and xAI **Grok Bot** — on real accounts, took 98 screenshots, and wrote down a verdict on every feature: adopt, adapt, or reject.

Instar already does most of what these advertise. So the useful question was never "what features do they have" — it was **"what have they solved about *showing* an agent that we haven't."** Almost everything worth taking is presentational.

**The headline.** All three independently arrive at the same idea: the agent should show what it did and what it was allowed to do, together, always visible. Instar records strictly more of that than any of them — every gate decision, every override reason, every mandate — and shows strictly less of it. That gap is the argument for the rebuild in one sentence.

**The single best thing to steal** is Grok's "Take over / I'm done": the agent hits a wall only a human can pass (a login, a consent, an identity field), hands the human its own live session, and resumes when they're done. Nothing restarts, no credential changes hands. I can vouch for the cost of not having it — that exact wall stopped this research three times in one night, and each time the only move available was to send a message and wait.

**The discoverability finding** is that it's a content problem, not a layout problem. Grok's entire product navigates from five sidebar items, and its scheduler is a gallery of finished outcomes grouped by what you care about — News, Productivity, Finance — one line each, one button. Rebuilds AgentRags as an evening paper and makes it safe for Grokbot to run every night.

ko.summary: 작성자는 AgentRags를 석간신문처럼 다시 만들고 Grokbot이 매일 밤 안전하게 돌릴 수 있게 했다. 선정 기사마다 고정 페이지가 있고, X나 매체 이미지 핫링크 대신 Grokbot 일러스트나 생성 커버를 쓰며 /api/needs-images.json이 Grokbot의 작업 목록이다. 매 빌드 전 check_data.py가 돌아 데이터가 잘못되면 실패해 마지막 정상 배포를 유지하고, GROKBOT.md가 누가 무엇을 바꿀지 정한다.

ms.title: AgentRags direka semula supaya Grokbot boleh menjalankannya setiap malam
ms.summary: Penulis membina semula AgentRags sebagai akhbar petang yang selamat dijalankan Grokbot setiap malam: setiap pilihan ada halaman cerita kekal; tiada imej X atau penerbit yang dipaut terus, hanya ilustrasi Grokbot atau kulit yang dijana, dengan /api/needs-images.json sebagai senarai kerja Grokbot; check_data.py berjalan sebelum setiap binaan dan gagal jika data rosak supaya penggunaan terakhir yang baik kekal; GROKBOT.md menetapkan siapa boleh ubah apa.

vi.title: Làm lại AgentRags để Grokbot chạy an toàn mỗi đêm
vi.summary: Tác giả dựng lại AgentRags thành một tờ báo chiều an toàn để Grokbot chạy mỗi đêm: mỗi bài chọn có trang cố định; không còn dẫn ảnh trực tiếp từ X hay báo, chỉ dùng tranh minh họa của Grokbot hoặc bìa tạo sẵn, với /api/needs-images.json là danh sách việc của Grokbot; check_data.py chạy trước mỗi lần build và thất bại khi dữ liệu sai để giữ bản triển khai tốt gần nhất; GROKBOT.md quy định ai được sửa gì.

fr.title: AgentRags refondu pour que Grokbot le fasse tourner chaque nuit
fr.summary: L’auteur a refait AgentRags en journal du soir, sûr pour une exécution nocturne par Grokbot : chaque sélection a sa page permanente ; plus d’images X ou d’éditeurs en lien direct, seulement les illustrations de Grokbot ou des couvertures générées, avec /api/needs-images.json comme liste de tâches ; check_data.py tourne avant chaque build et échoue sur des données invalides pour garder le dernier bon déploiement ; GROKBOT.md fixe qui peut modifier quoi.

es.title: AgentRags rediseñado para que Grokbot lo ejecute cada noche
es.summary: El autor rehízo AgentRags como un diario vespertino seguro para que Grokbot lo ejecute cada noche: cada noticia elegida tiene página permanente; nada de imágenes enlazadas de X o medios, solo ilustraciones de Grokbot o portadas generadas, con /api/needs-images.json como lista de tareas; check_data.py corre antes de cada build y falla con datos mal formados para mantener el último despliegue bueno; GROKBOT.md define quién puede cambiar qué.

de.title: AgentRags umgebaut, damit Grokbot es jede Nacht betreiben kann
de.summary: Der Autor baute AgentRags zu einer Abendzeitung um, die Grokbot nachts sicher betreiben kann: Jeder Beitrag erhält eine feste Seite; keine direkt verlinkten Bilder von X oder Verlagen, nur Grokbots Illustrationen oder generierte Cover, mit /api/needs-images.json als Arbeitsliste; check_data.py läuft vor jedem Build und bricht bei fehlerhaften Daten ab, damit der letzte gute Stand live bleibt; GROKBOT.md regelt, wer was ändern darf.
